svg.title: P012 · Price and discount statistics per category
svg.desc: One row of price statistics per category. The extended example puts product IDs 1, 2, 3 in category 10 and IDs 4, 5 in category 20. Category 10 has prices 80, 100, 30. Its minimum is 30, maximum is 100 and average is 210 / 3 = 70. Read the products again. ID 2 contributes one full-price flag. IDs 3 and 5 have unusable market prices and contribute NULL percentages. Category 10 averages (20% + 0%) / 2 = 10%. Category 20 averages its single known percentage, 25%. All five products still count. FROM Products · one table is enough. The group key is the category ID already on each product. The same rows hold both price columns, so they supply the product count and every price statistic.

follow. SQL excerpts use … for omitted clauses.
